summary: Student Accommodation · Available August 2024 · £120pppw · Excellent Jesmond location · Three equal sized bedrooms
description:
My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the student market this very stylish, classic ground floor Tyneside flat which has been given a contemporary upgrade to a high standard throughout. It is located within a close walking distance to West Jesmond metro station with good local bus services and road links in and out of the City Centre. There is an array of local shops on Brentwood Avenue and a small walk to Acorn Road and Osborne Road for a vast range of cafes, bars restaurants and other shopping.

The property accommodation comprises: A light and contemporary feel throughout with open plan living room and well appointed high gloss white kitchen, double glazing throughout, gas central heating, three double bedrooms, shower room with corner cubicle, private rear decked patio yard and off street parking space. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB and speak to the Lettings Team.
